svg.title: Five Controls Between Intake and Repaid Capital
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-escrow-locked-funding-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: Five Controls Between Intake and Repaid Capital; subtitle: A 24-to-72-hour funding interval begins at confirmed outbound settlement, not at the first borrower inquiry.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: This workflow authorizes releases only to bonded title or settlement agents after independently verifying unconditional end-buyer cash on deposit. Traditional early EMD requests without that cash fail this release standard. The workflow does not equate a wire receipt with settled, available funds.; caption: Keep principal movements, earned funding fees, and capital-provider repayments in separate ledger accounts; close each exposure only after the return wire and fee allocation reconcile.; stages: label: Document the transaction; value: Collect contracts, entity records, and funding requests.; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use a structured intake form and permission-restricted document room. Capture both purchase contracts, borrower authority, property jurisdiction, requested principal, expected payoff, and the proposed 24-to-72-hour interval. Issue proof of funds only against verified available cash or a documented, drawable capital commitment.; label: Underwrite repayment; value: Match buyer cash against every required disbursement.; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Obtain the settlement statement and agent-confirmed available buyer cash. Test whether unconditional proceeds cover funded principal, earned charges, liens, taxes, and closing costs without another sale or unfunded loan. Reject dry-closing assumptions and conditional buyer deposits.; label: Authenticate the settlement agent; value: Verify authority, bond coverage, and bank coordinates.; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check the applicable regulator's license record, bond or coverage evidence, and title-underwriter relationship where relevant. Call a previously verified number, not one supplied in a changed wire email. Independently match beneficiary ownership and account details.; label: Release under written instructions; value: Require independent verification before owner-authorized wiring.; numeric value: 4.0; detail: The underwriting contractor records verification; the owner separately authorizes the wire. Written escrow instructions specify permitted disbursements, closing conditions, payoff order, and return handling. A changed beneficiary or missing cash confirmation stops release.; label: Reconcile payoff and earnings; value: Close principal exposure before distributing earned returns.; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match bank settlement identifiers to the Qualia or SoftPro closing file and the QuickBooks payoff ledger. Record principal as recovery of funding, not revenue. Recognize only earned contractual fees, operator EMD JV allocations, and origination points under the applicable revenue-recognition assessment.
